name: io.github.Akkiruk/craftos-mcp
description: Headless CC:Tweaked 1.101.3 emulator: run, test and screenshot ComputerCraft Lua programs.

environmentVariables.name: CRAFTOS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Folder with your Lua project (default: the server's own workspace folder).

environmentVariables.name: CRAFTOS_ADDONS
environmentVariables.description: Mods to simulate besides CC:Tweaked: all, none, or comma-separated ids such as create,mekanism.
